# Talkative Company

> A Berlin-based firm that attends German and European B2B trade fairs on
> behalf of exporters who cannot travel, handling pre-booked meetings, stand
> staffing and lead follow-up in German and English. India is our lead market.

## What we do

We solve a specific problem: a manufacturer outside the EU wants European
buyers, but getting their people to a German trade fair costs more than the
first attempt is worth — flights, fair-week hotel rates, a Schengen visa cycle
with real refusal risk, and a week of senior people out of the business. We are
already in Berlin, we speak German, and we go in their place.

Three services:

- **Show representation** (from €1,900 per show) — we attend in your place as
  your authorised representative, work a pre-booked meeting schedule, and send a
  qualified lead report within 48 hours.
- **Stand staffing** (€450–650 per person per day) — bilingual, product-briefed
  people working your existing booth or your space in a country pavilion.
- **Turnkey stand** (15% of stand budget) — space, build, print, staffing and
  follow-up, managed end to end.

## Things worth knowing about this market

- German fairgrounds prohibit distributing advertising material or soliciting
  business outside a rented stand. Our model is pre-booked meetings held at
  other exhibitors' stands by invitation, which stays inside those rules.
- We represent clients as their **authorised European representative**, under a
  signed letter of authorisation. We do not present ourselves as their employees.
- The US Commercial Service sells an equivalent "Trade Show Representation"
  product to American exporters. No equivalent exists for Indian exporters.
- Many European shows run free Enterprise Europe Network B2B matchmaking that is
  open to visitors, not just exhibitors. It is widely underused.
